title: Cap. VI Arg. 11: Rom. 8:28 — all things work for good for the predestined and called
pass_a_gloss: Hither also tends that of the Apostle, Rom. 8:28: All things work together for good for those who are predestinated, and called according to purpose. Namely by the special providence of God so directing all things, that those which seem most hostile to their salvation nonetheless promote the same.
pass_b_english: So also Paul, Rom. 8:28: all things work together for good for those who are predestined and called according to purpose — God's special providence so steering all things that what looks most hostile to their salvation still advances it.
source_text: Huc etiam tendit illud Apostoli, Rom. viii. 28: Omnia in bonum eorum cooperantur, qui praedestinati sunt, et secundum propositum vocati. Speciali nimirum Dei providentia ita res omnes dirigente, ut quae maxime infesta videantur illorum saluti, eandem nihilo minus promoveant.
